description: Divisional Secretariat - Badulla - Annual Perahara of Badulla Katharagama Devalaya - 2021
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the organization and regulation of a religious/cultural event (the Annual Perahara of Badull Katharagama Devalaya). It involves administrative orders regarding event scheduling, routes, and public health/safety regulations, but does not fit any of the specialized categories 4-9. Since it is not about government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and concerns cultural/administrative matters, it falls under Miscellaneous (Type 10).
